prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire in 30 Seconds
plan.description: A quick guide to changing a flat tire safely. Learn the key steps: park safe, loosen the nuts, lift, swap the wheel.

beats.narration: Flat tire? You can fix it yourself. First, park on flat ground, pull the parking brake, and loosen the lug nuts before lifting.
Now jack up the car, remove the nuts, and pull the flat wheel off. Slide the spare on and hand-tighten the nuts.
Lower the car, then tighten the nuts in a star pattern. Check the spare's pressure, and get the flat repaired.
